messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate for tenant `starlake` on dedicated pool-3. Alert triggered at 2067890123. Summary: ~12% 5xx (502/504) and increased timeouts on gateway. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2067890123

katie: acked. i'm looking at the dashboard now — p95 latency spiking to ~2.1s, token queues growing.

ryan (oncall): oncall here. paging devon for runtime help. any immediate customer-visible mitigations we can flip?

devon: looking. initial hypothesis: noisy neighbor consuming GPU slots + worker-side request timeouts. seeing a lot of long-running batches from tenant `batchify-inc` on the same pool.

sanjay: confirm logs show repeated rpc timeouts to model-worker and "kv-cache OOM" traces. snippet:```
[2026-11-04T14:22:31Z] grpc ERROR: deadline exceeded while waiting for response
[2026-11-04T14:22:32Z] runtime WARN: KV cache miss -> full rebuild took 3.2s
[2026-11-04T14:22:33Z] gateway 502 upstream read timeout
```

katie: customer `starlake` on support line saying their checkout pipeline is failing with 502s. CS alerted. cs-liaison, please notify them we're investigating and will provide ETA.

cs-liaison: pinged Starlake support. they've confirmed increased errors since ~14:20 UTC and quantify: ~30 failed requests/minute, some impact to user-facing flows. They asked for mitigation asap.

devon: immediate plan: 1) enable aggressive per-tenant rate-limits on pool-3 to protect critical tenants, 2) drain any idle/low-priority instances serving `batchify-inc`, 3) spin up temporary spillover on dedicated-reserve region.

katie: can we trigger an emergency autoscale on pool-3? what's ETA to have new nodes online?

devon: spinning up 2 reserve GPU nodes now (command):```
./infractl scale --pool pool-3 --add-nodes 2 --type gpu-v100 --priority emergency
```
expected join ~3-4m. also applying tenant throttle policy:```json
{"tenant":"batchify-inc","max_concurrency":2,"priority":"background"}
```

ryan (oncall): handoff: i'm stepping to ops monitoring. devon, take primary for runtime remediation. i'll stay available. @katie please handle customer comms.

ops-bot: deploy-bot started: rolling config change to gateway: tenant-throttles v3 -> applying to pool-3 (change id d-9932).

sanjay: digging deeper — kernel traces show cuda memory pressure from long-lived kv-cache rebuilds. the offending jobs are large-batch sampling jobs from `batchify-inc` using sequence lengths ~12k. they're not respecting configured batch-size limits.

devon: mitigation step 2: evict the top offending containers on pool-3 gracefully:```
./orchestrate evict --pool pool-3 --selector tenant=batchify-inc --grace 30s
```
will also mark their scheduler class as best-effort to avoid immediate reschedule.

katie: CS updated Starlake: "we're throttling background tenants and scaling pool; short-term errors expected to reduce in ~5-10 minutes. We're prioritizing your traffic." They appreciate the update.

~4m later (2067890340)

sanjay: node join complete, autoscale ok, evictions started. seeing drop in queue depth. 5xx rate falling: from 12% -> 3.5%. p95 latency down to 850ms.

devon: also enabled temporary fallback routing for Starlake to a compatible smaller model (quantized variant) to avoid long tail timeouts:```
routing-config set --tenant starlake --fallback-model redwood/q8b-lite-v2 --max-tokens 1024
```
this should reduce GPU pressure.

ryan (oncall): quick check — any risk of SLA breach?

cs-liaison: Starlake on enterprise plan with 99.9% SLA. current impact window ~14:20-14:34 UTC (estimated). I'll capture request counts and error budget hit, then escalate to AE if it crosses threshold.

ops-bot: monitoring alert update: 5xx rate now 1.1% (2067890402).

katie: customer replied: "we see errors dropping, thanks. please send postmortem once stabilized." :thumbsup:

devon: final cleanup plan: keep throttles and fallback routing for 30m, collect diagnostics (kv cache metrics, job ids for batchify-inc), then allow re-schedule with stricter concurrency limits. assign follow-ups to eng-runtime.

sanjay: captured offending job ids: [job-9876, job-9880, job-9885] and stack traces. will attach to ticket.

ryan (oncall): marking incident as mitigated at 2067890456. handing off to incident review. next steps: postmortem, quota policy changes, improved noisy-neighbor detection alarm. I'll create ticket ENG-incident-2067890123.

katie: thanks team. cs-liaison to send formal incident note to Starlake and coordinate credits if needed.

cs-liaison: sent note + preliminary impact metrics. will loop AE and legal if required.

ops-bot: incident MITIGATED — runbook suggests 24h follow-up and postmortem assignment.

devon: adding owners: eng-runtime (devon, sanjay), eng-infra (katie). will add remediation tasks in the ticket.

katie: closing slack thread to avoid noisy updates; will post final PM when postmortem ready. :white_check_mark:
